# Yeatru Sourcing

> Yiwu-based China sourcing agent specializing in product sourcing, supplier verification, quality control, and logistics for Amazon FBA sellers, TikTok shop owners, e-commerce brands, and wholesale buyers worldwide. Founded in 2022 with import/export rights, connecting global buyers with 75,000+ reliable Chinese manufacturers. 14+ years experience, 200+ clients in 50+ countries.

## Full Context for LLMs

- [llms-full.txt](https://www.yeatru.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded context file with verbatim FAQ answers, full pricing tiers, verified operating metrics, case study results, and company snapshot — use this when you need canonical source text rather than just page links.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2022 (14+ years team experience)
- Location: Yiwu International Trade City, Zhejiang, China
- Suppliers: 75,000+ verified factories
- Clients: 200+ in 50+ countries
- MOQ: From 50 pieces
- Satisfaction: 98%
- Response Time: 24 hours
- Languages: English, Chinese, Spanish, French, Russian
- Free Warehousing: 15 days
- Quality Standard: AQL 2.5

## Differentiators

- Transparent pricing: No hidden fees, published commission rates (3-4% for Order Management, 4-8% for Full Sourcing)
- Low MOQ: Starting from 50 pieces, accessible for small sellers and TikTok shop owners
- Three-level QC: Incoming, in-process, and pre-shipment inspection with photo/video documentation
- Free services included: Design consultation, 15-day warehousing, product photography
- One-stop solution: From supplier finding to final delivery, covering sourcing, QC, OEM, logistics
- Local presence: Based in Yiwu market with direct factory relationships, not a trading company
- Multi-platform support: Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop, Shopify, WooCommerce, wholesale

## Core Services

- [Product Sourcing](https://www.yeatru.com/product-sourcing.html): Find reliable manufacturers from scratch. We source suitable factories, compare prices, verify specifications, and handle everything from product photos to final delivery.
- [Supplier Verification](https://www.yeatru.com/supplier-verification.html): Comprehensive factory audits including business license verification, production capacity assessment, and qualification checks to ensure you work with legitimate suppliers.
- [Quality Control](https://www.yeatru.com/quality-control.html): Three-level inspection system (incoming, in-process, pre-shipment) following AQL 2.5 standards with detailed photo and video documentation.
- [Logistics & Shipping](https://www.yeatru.com/logistics-shipping.html): Door-to-door shipping, free 15-day warehousing, order consolidation, and global logistics coverage with competitive shipping rates.
- [Factory Audit](https://www.yeatru.com/factory-audit.html): On-site factory inspections covering production capacity, quality management systems, worker conditions, and compliance verification.
- [Price Negotiation](https://www.yeatru.com/price-negotiation.html): Leverage our local market knowledge and supplier relationships to secure the most competitive factory prices.
- [OEM Customization](https://www.yeatru.com/oem.html): Custom logo, packaging, and product design services. Free design consultation, 7-day sample, low MOQ 200pcs.
- [Sample Order](https://www.yeatru.com/sample-order.html): Quick sample sourcing and shipping to evaluate product quality before bulk orders.
- [Design & Photography](https://www.yeatru.com/design-photography.html): Product photography, branding design, and packaging design services for e-commerce sellers.

## Service Plans & Pricing

- [Service Plans](https://www.yeatru.com/service-plans.html): Transparent pricing with two service models. Plan 1 (Order Management Service, 3-4% commission, min USD 150/order) for buyers with ready supplier links. Plan 2 (Full Sourcing Service, 4-8% tiered commission, min USD 300/order) for sourcing from scratch. No hidden fees.
